headline: Executive order directs changes meant to make the Office of the Federal Register work more efficiently.
what_it_does: This executive order focuses on the Office of the Federal Register, the federal office that publishes official government rules, notices, and presidential documents. Based on its title, it calls for changes to make that office run more efficiently. No summary was provided, so the specific changes are not described here.

who_it_affects.group: Office of the Federal Register staff
who_it_affects.how: The office's operations may change under the order's efficiency directions.

who_it_affects.group: Federal agencies that publish rules and notices
who_it_affects.how: Agencies may see changes in how their documents are handled or published.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed May 9, 2025; specific effective dates for any changes are not stated in the available information.
